name: react-upstream-merge
title: Merge upstream React rewrite: port LCDX features onto new baseline
description: Upstream RinNET_frontend rewrote the portal from Angular 16 to React 19 + Vite + shadcn/ui (41 commits, synced into local `backup` branch). A git merge is impossible (entire src/app deleted/replaced). Strategy: adopt `backup` as the new baseline and port all LCDX custom features (dual-backend API, cabinet management pages, permission model, merge-request importer flow, i18n 982 keys, misc page tweaks) onto the React architecture, then move `master` forward.
creator: Xavior
